"WITH t_union as (
SELECT 
	rtrim(t_report.vidotcheta) as vidotcheta,
	t_report.domen_key,
	t_report.be,
	t_report.be_key,
	t_report.org_key,
	t_card.id_deal,
	t_card.id_dogovor,
	t_report.project_key,
	t_report.project_code,
	t_card.type_project,
	t_card.stage_project,
	t_card.current_status_project,
	t_product_name.description,
	t_card.customer,
	t_card.vgo_customer,
	t_card.kam,
	t_report.cfo_or_organizacii,
	t_card.current_segment,
	extract(year from t_report.datanachala) as nyear,
	extract(month from t_report.datanachala) as nmonth,
	t_report.summa,
	t_report.mvz_key,
	t_report.ekdr_code,
	t_report.vid_dds
FROM detail_uh.sat_valuereports2 as t_report 
INNER JOIN detail_uh.ders_project_card as t_card 
	ON t_report.project_key = t_card.project_key 
LEFT OUTER JOIN detail_uh.sat_ctlg_projects_t1_product as t_product_key 
	ON t_report.project_key = t_product_key.ref_key 
	AND t_product_key.linenumber = 1 
LEFT OUTER JOIN detail_uh.hub_ctlg_t1_product as t_product_name 
	ON t_product_key.product_key = t_product_name.ref_key

	AND versiya_deletionmark = '0' 
	AND scenarii = 'Прогноз' 
	AND rtrim(vidotcheta) = 'БДР' 
	AND stage_project = 'Исполнение'
